summary: TOMI Environmental Solutions filed an 8-K reporting the unexpected death of CFO David Vanston on May 11, 2026, and the immediate appointment of Niroshan Srirathan as Interim CFO effective May 16, 2026. The filing details Srirathan's compensation ($180,000 base salary) and background as Controller since May 2026, with prior roles at Vistry Group and Berkeley Group. The board did not provide recommendation or advisor. The event is an abrupt, involuntary departure due to death, triggering a CFO change. Watch for permanent CFO search updates and potential succession planning impact.
